SA: a small fix that people actually use is better than a big idea
CR: Each one was fixed quickly, but nobody looked at why it kept happening.
EV: It was costing the team hours every week.
IJ: We tried it for a month, and [the errors dropped by about half].
CV: First, you don't need a title to fix a problem.

SA.explanation: She outlines two explicit lessons about taking initiative without a title and focusing on small, usable fixes.
Her learning is directly linked to her initiative of tracking data entry errors and creating a checklist.

EV.explanation: She demonstrates how the recurring errors affected the team by costing them hours every week.

CV.explanation: She asserts a strong point of view that anyone can fix problems by doing the boring work.
